# neptune

Neptune gremlin/openCypher/SPARQL access - bounded traversals only - plus cluster encryption posture from dumps.

## Error codes

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `AF-NEPTUNE-DUMP` | `cluster.json` missing or invalid |
| `AF-NEPTUNE-PARSE` | a `*.py` file fails to parse |
| `AF-NEPTUNE-HEURISTIC-BINDING` | receivers matched by name, not constructor |
| `AF-GRAPH-FORMAT` | export format named but not implemented (e.g. `neptune`) |
